summary: Murdoch Partners (murdochpartners.com.au) is a Kew, Melbourne accounting, tax and advisory firm with a private wealth arm, serving SMEs and strong in medical and allied health clients. In July 2025 Tim Wulf was appointed Principal with a stated mandate to embed emerging technologies in client engagement, and the firm's careers page names Xero, FYI, BGL360 and CAS 360 as its stack. Martin Sammut is Managing Partner and has been with the firm since 2006. The firm looks tech-curious, which makes Tim the stronger first contact.

hooks.text: Tim's July 2025 appointment as Principal came with a remit to embed emerging technologies in client engagement, so he owns the tech agenda and is the right first contact.
Tim's cash flow management and financial reporting focus means clean, reconciled books on time feed straight into the advice his clients value; reconciliation is the bottleneck before that advice.
Stack of Xero, FYI and BGL360 with medical, veterinary and SME clients gives a concrete picture of the reconciliation load.

risks.text: A graduate on the team describes building and teaching AI workflows for client data, so the firm may be experimenting with DIY AI; the pitch should lead with traceability and audit trail.
Firm is tax and advisory-led with a wealth arm, so bookkeeping volume may be modest.
Martin Sammut (primary contact on record) is a long-tenured Managing Partner on the tax side; Tim is the better first contact for technology.

gaps: No podcast, YouTube, Facebook or Instagram content found for the firm, Tim or Martin.
No Xero/MYOB partner directory listing found.
Could not find any Murdoch Partners reconciliation or bookkeeping service page.
No posts by Tim beyond the July 2025 announcement surfaced.
